result.summary: FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Read-only review of Actions trust boundaries, tag/input injection, job permissions, artifact reuse and draft release gates: 3 MEDIUM, 1 LOW. F1 MEDIUM release.yml:156 no digest for the downloadable .tar.gz; SHA256SUMS lists only the extracted executable, so 'sha256sum -c' fails in the download dir and the release notes cannot be followed (reproduced, exit 1). F2 MEDIUM release.yml:125 non-GitHub action oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 (mutable tag) runs in the only contents:write job, after checkout persisted that token into .git/config. F3 MEDIUM release.yml:7 the workflow file comes from the tagged commit, so the draft-only gate is attacker-controllable for branch writers (tag protection unverified). F4 LOW package.ts:402 loose SHA256SUMS/metadata published uncompared with the archive copies (unreachable today). Tag gate, permissions split, run-scoped artifact reuse and draft gate verified clean; no source changes.
result.details:
Setup: detached disposable clone at /tmp/rev46, git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead, clean, no commits/pushes.

FINDINGS (detail in /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json):
F1 MEDIUM .github/workflows/release.yml:156 (root cause scripts/package.ts:75-77,304,351,402). checksums() emits exactly one line for the extracted executable; archiveSha256 is computed but only returned on stdout, never written to a shipped file; release.yml:157-159 attaches only the .tar.gz, SHA256SUMS and metadata-<v>.json. Consequence: an installer cannot integrity-check the archive before extraction and the release-note instruction fails. Reproduced: pure-function probe shows the manifest content; synthesized 3-file asset dir then 'sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS' exited 1 ('swarmforge: FAILED open or read'); neither manifest nor metadata mentions the tarball. Not prevented because verifyArchive/prepareReleaseAssets only prove things inside the tarball, and tests assert asset names/workflow substrings only.
F2 MEDIUM .github/workflows/release.yml:125-127 (also 31-33). oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 is a non-GitHub action on a mutable tag and runs in draft-release, the only job with contents: write; the preceding checkout@v4 leaves the write-scoped token in .git/config (no persist-credentials: false), so any later step can read it. Consequence: repo write/release creation from a moved or compromised tag. Not prevented: packaging.test.ts:932-953 only checks the permissions split. Precondition unverified (not reproducible locally).
F3 MEDIUM .github/workflows/release.yml:7-11. 'on: push: tags v*' runs the workflow file from the tagged commit, so a branch-write collaborator can tag their own commit with a release.yml that drops --draft, escalating branch write into an immediate published release; README documents releases as the install channel. Only in-workflow gates exist (event-name check and package.ts tag), both attacker-supplied. Not prevented: tests assert the draft flag only in the reviewed file. Reachability depends on repo rulesets/tag protection, which I did not inspect (read-only review) - flagged as code-evidenced with unverified platform precondition.
F4 LOW scripts/package.ts:402 with release.yml:157-159. Published SHA256SUMS/metadata are the loose recursive findFile results, never digest-compared with the copies inside the verified archive. Not reachable today (packageCli writes both from the same content); hardening gap.

VERIFIED CLEAN: no ${{ }} inside any run: body; releaseTagMismatch (probe, exit 0) rejects ;/$(...)/backtick/newline/quote/--title=x/-v1.2.3/refs/tags evil/v01.2.3/-rc1 and accepts only exact vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH == package.json version, so a tag can never become a gh flag; write confined to draft-release which needs build + pushed tag; download-artifact gets one run-scoped artifact by exact name with no rebuild; --draft present, --publish absent.

PROBES: (1) cd /tmp/probe46 && bun p1.ts exit 0; (2) synthesized asset dir sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS exit 1 as intended; (3) python3 yaml.safe_load of release.yml exit 0. NOT RUN: full bun test (whole-suite reviewer) and bun run build/package (packaging scope; sandbox Bun is 1.3.14, compilation needs 1.4.2, and no finding depends on a compiled binary). packaging.test.ts read as code evidence, not executed.

LIMITATIONS: no ruleset/tag-protection/permission inspection, so F3's platform precondition and F2's compromise precondition are unverified; upload-artifact v4 root-dir behaviour not executable locally (a nested layout would fail closed, so not filed). No cloud/model providers, no real infrastructure smoke, no credentials read or emitted. Reviewer experiments only in /tmp/rev46 and /tmp/probe46.

ARTIFACTS: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md + findings.json; logs /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev46-probe-{p1,sha,yaml}.log.

tests.summary: 3 bounded local probes, exit codes 0 / 1 (intended) / 0; logs in /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev46-probe-{p1,sha,yaml}.log. Probes confirmed the tag-mismatch matrix, the SHA256SUMS/metadata contents and the workflow trigger/permission graph. bun test (full suite) and bun run build/package deliberately not run: full suite is the whole-suite reviewer's job and compiling belongs to packaging scope (sandbox Bun 1.3.14 cannot compile with the 1.4.2 compile API). packaging.test.ts read, not executed. Result JSON validated against src/domain.ts resultSchema from the target using zod 4.3.6 installed under /tmp/zodval.

warnings: F3 and F2 depend on settings outside the repository (tag protection / rulesets, default workflow permissions) and on upstream action-tag integrity; neither was verified because this review was read-only and inspected no infrastructure.
Severity of F3 would drop to LOW if the repository already requires release tags to target commits reachable from the protected default branch; that configuration was not inspected.

Full test suite and compiled-binary packaging were intentionally not run; no finding depends on them, but the workflow gates themselves were validated by reading the code and by pure-function probes only.

env.BUN_VERSION (release.yml:19) is unused - the version is hardcoded in both setup-bun steps and in the verify step, so the toolchain pin has three edit sites; the hardcoded 'test $(bun --version) = 1.4.2' fails loudly on drift, so this is a maintenance note, not a defect.

Reviewer experiments are outside the source checkout and are disclosed: /tmp/rev46 (detached clone at the exact target) and /tmp/probe46 (probe script and synthetic asset dir); /workspace/repo was not modified.
result.followup_reason: Three MEDIUM release-trust findings need an owner: publish and verify an archive-level digest so the downloadable tarball can be checked (F1, release.yml:156); pin third-party actions to commit SHAs and stop persisting the write-scoped token in the draft job (F2, release.yml:125); add a tag-protection ruleset plus protected-environment/ref_protected gate so a tag on an arbitrary branch cannot publish a release (F3, release.yml:7). Report: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md.
